class.name: GDScriptHelper
class.brief_description: Exposes GDScript editor-language analysis to scripts.
class.description: [GDScriptHelper] validates GDScript source, returns its function outline, requests code completion, and resolves symbols without opening the script editor. [b]Note:[/b] This class is available only in editor builds. Completion and context-sensitive lookup source must contain [code]String.chr(0xffff)[/code] at the cursor position.

method.name: get_completion_hint
method.description: Returns the call hint produced by the last successful [method set_completion_code] request.

method.name: get_completion_options
method.description: Returns completion dictionaries from the last [method set_completion_code] request. Each dictionary contains [code]type[/code], [code]display_text[/code], [code]insert_text[/code], and [code]default_value[/code].

method.name: get_errors
method.description: Returns validation errors from the last [method set_validate_code] request. Each dictionary contains zero-based [code]line[/code] and [code]column[/code] values and a [code]message[/code].

method.name: get_functions
method.description: Returns a dictionary that maps function names to zero-based declaration lines from the last successful [method set_validate_code] request.

method.name: has_completion_hint
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the last completion request produced a call hint.

method.name: has_completion_options
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the last completion request produced at least one option.

method.name: has_errors
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the last validation request produced at least one error.

method.name: has_functions
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the last successful validation request found at least one function.

method.name: is_completion_forced
method.description: Returns whether completion should take priority over the call hint for the last request.

method.name: lookup_code
method.description: Resolves [param symbol] in [param code]. On success, returns a dictionary containing [code]type[/code], [code]script[/code], [code]class_name[/code], [code]class_member[/code], [code]class_path[/code], and [code]location[/code]. Returns an empty dictionary if the symbol cannot be resolved.

method.name: set_completion_code
method.description: Analyzes [param code] and stores its completion options and call hint. The source must contain [code]String.chr(0xffff)[/code] at the cursor position.

method.name: set_validate_code
method.description: Validates [param code], stores its errors and function outline, and returns [code]true[/code] if the source has no errors.
